_om: Bingoballen in English (Bingo Ball, rusj.no/en/bingo-ball/). Key = the Norwegian text in spill.js. Party themes in data.en/temaer.json. Shared words (Nytt spill, Alle spill …) come from rusj/kit/tekst.en.json.
Koden har {n} tegn – du har skrevet {ant: The code has {n} characters – you've typed {antall}.
Koden stemmer ikke. Sjekk at den er skre: That code doesn't work. Check it's typed correctly.
Bingo der alle har brettet på sin egen m: Bingo where everyone has their card on their own phone. Choose number bingo with 75 balls, or party bingo with moments that happen at the party.
Den som starter, viser QR-koden. Alle sk: Whoever starts shows the QR code. Everyone scans it and gets their own card with a fixed number.
Tallbingo: verten trekker baller, og du: Number bingo: the caller draws the balls and you tap the numbers you have. Party bingo: tap the moments as they happen.
Første hele rekke vinner – vannrett, lod: The first full line wins – across, down or diagonally. In number bingo the caller checks your card by its number.
I tallbingo kan dere spille videre om to: In number bingo you can play on for two lines and a full house after the first bingo.
Brettet låses til mobilen. Går du ut og: Your card is locked to your phone. Leave and rejoin with the same code and you'll get the same card.
Midtruta i tallbingo er fri – den teller: The middle square in number bingo is free – it always counts as marked.
Festbingo passer til julebord, julaften,: Party bingo suits a Christmas party, Christmas Day, New Year's Eve, a wedding, a birthday, Bonfire Night, a night at the pub and a hen or stag do.
Verten kan slå på automatisk trekning og: The caller can switch on automatic draws and play too with ‘My card’.
The link doesn't contain a valid code.
Brettnummeret har seks sifre. Det står ø: The card number has six digits. It's at the top of the card.
Everyone has their card on their phone.
Merk det som skjer på festen: Mark what happens at the party
Med automatisk trekning kan du spille se: With automatic draws you can play too, with a card of your own.
Alle får et eget brett på sin mobil – me: Everyone gets their own card on their phone – by QR code or code. No app, no account.
Eller åpne Bingoballen, trykk «Bli med i: Or open Bingo Ball, tap ‘Join a game’ and type the code.
Hver mobil får sitt eget brett: Every phone gets its own card
Brettnummeret står øverst. Vis det til v: The card number is at the top. Show it to the caller when you shout BINGO!
Trykk på øyeblikkene når de skjer. Først: Tap the moments as they happen. First full line wins.
Trykk «Trekk ball» når alle har brettet: Tap ‘Draw a ball’ when everyone has their card.
Med mobilens norske stemme: With the phone's own English voice
Skriv nummeret som står øverst på brette: Type the number at the top of the card. You're playing for
Kanskje neste gang? Det er lov å prøve i: Maybe next time? You're allowed another go.
Skann QR-koden med kameraet – eller skri: Scan the QR code with your camera – or type the code from the phone of whoever started.
Hel rekke! Rop BINGO og vis brettnummere: Full line! Shout BINGO and show the caller your card number.
Trykk på tallene du har når de blir ropt: Tap your numbers when they're called.
Full line! Shout BINGO so everyone hears.
Trykk på et øyeblikk når det skjer. Hel: Tap a moment when it happens. A full line wins.
Alt skjedde. For en fest!: It all happened. What a party!
Du har en hel rekke. Vis de andre hva so: You've got a full line. Show the others what happened:
Spill videre mot fullt brett: Play on for a full house
Bli med på bingo! Trykk på lenken for å: Join in with bingo! Tap the link to get your own card – or type the code {kode}.
Dere går til kåringen med vinnerne så la: You'll go to the results with the winners so far.
Koden slutter å vises her. Brettene på m: The code won't be shown here any more. The cards on the phones still work.
Rop det høyt – og vis brettet ditt til v: Shout it out – and show your card to the caller.
Verten skriver nummeret og sjekker talle: The caller types in the number and checks your numbers.
Your card is locked to this phone. Rejoin with the same code and you'll get the same card.
